notes.title: Mirror Party - A Gaiden of the Mirror Series Store Page Release
notes.content:
A huge crisis broke out in the Mirror-verse. In the name of justice (or probably mischief), the bishojos went to war! Select your heroine and fight! The mini-game collection of Mirror-verse: Mirror Party. 

This is the first time we try to develop a game that combined minigames and collectibles. Play the minigames with your friends and families to get the Gacha Tokens, throw them in the Gacha Machine, and get OVER 300 pieces of collectibles: CGs/Cosplay Album/Video/OST, and more! 

[i]※The game is in Early Access. We plan to eventually increase minigames to 12 ones and collectibles 1000+. [/i]


[h3]Recent Update of the Development of Mirror 2: [/h3]

We know that many of you are concerned with the recent development of Mirror 2. 

We'd like to thank you for your support! We've been reading every review that you posted since day 1 Mirror was released. We value your input and feedback on this game very seriously. 

Early-stage into the development of Mirror 2, we immediately felt how challenging it is to switch from 2D to 3D technical-wise. It's so much more than we initially expected. We're kinda like toddlers trying to learn how to run like Usain Bolt. 

But we carried on, we've found the power to push us through the difficulties a long time ago - We just want to make a fun game, it's simple as that. All the pain, sweat, and hardship are just a part of the journey. We're still in the process of leveling up, we're still trying to clear the obstacles, we're learning new stuff every day. So we have to apologize, that Mirror 2 needs more time to polish before we can show it to you all. 

But the good news is, although having many obstacles, we've done something right and some part of the game already looks pretty good. It's not as pretty as we'd like it to be, but still, we managed to make a formal trailer, so you can have a basic understanding of how the game is going to be like. We hope you can see our passion and love for the game. And we'd like to hear what you would like to say about our progress so far. 

Thank you again for your love and support over the years. And still, we're going to the best we can! 
[previewyoutube=mmYS6_E98E4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: UPDATE V1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]  Fixed the bug that may potentially cause the game to freeze. 
How the bug manifests: Sometimes the game just freezes and gamer would lose control of it, which happens randomly. But the BGM remained normal. Restarting the game usually helps. 

The initial analysis is that the bug was caused by the limitation of the engine - it happens to other games that are developed using this engine. 

And due to our own technical limitations, we weren't able to find a fix after the release of it. 

Right before the launch of our latest endeavor - Firework, we found a thread on a forum discussing fixing this bug. There's a solution provided by DRILL from project1 forum. We implemented it and from the feedback we get from Firework customers, the bug was fixed. So we're now able to fix it for Tales of the Black Forest. 

We're very sorry that it took us too long to find a solution to the problem. And we'd like to thank DRILL from project1 forum for lending a hand. 

[*]  Added a tip about controls at the home screen. 
We've been getting feedback that the mouse isn't working in the game, which is intentional because the game has hidden the indicator. We've added a tip or some guidance at the home screen of the game so our gamers wouldn't miss it. 
[/list]
We browse the community forum regularly. So please open a thread if you have any questions to ask. 

Thank you for your love and support for our games. Please stay tuned for more in the future!

notes.title: New Game – Firework, Now Released!
notes.content:
What’s up, everybody! I’m 月光蟑螂, the game developer of 拾英Studio. I’ve received tons of praises and suggestions after the release of Tales of the Black Forest. Thank you for your love and support. 
I always believe that a polished and sophisticated game dedicated for the players is the best way express my gratitude. 

A year after the release of my first game, my second one – Firework is release as if now. 
This one is a detective game with a bit of horror element and a lot of Chinese-style storytelling. 
Comparing to the storyline of Tales of the Black Forest, it of the Firework is more down to the earth and maybe even relating to people. The game itself is as story driven as it can be and the tension of the gameplay is drastically different from Tales of the Black Forest. It’s a new challenge for me and with challenge comes risks. It’s been a year of crunching through the development, and I’m quite sure that Firework will bring you a completely new experience for you. 

It’ll be my honor if you are willing to support my latest effort, and I wish you an early Lunar New Year!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1288310/_/

notes.title: New game Firework is about to hit the shelf! Add it to your wishlist right now!
"Firework" -- A New Game From 拾英 Studio
notes.content:
Hi, this is 月光蟑螂, the developer of Tales of the Black Forest. 

First off, I wanna say thanks for all the love and support.

Lots of you guys ask me when can you get a sequel or else. 
Well today I’m here to announce that I’ve been developing a new game for quite some time. 

And today I’m going to show you guys the Store Page! 

The new game is called “Firework”. The story happens in a small town high up on the mountains at around ’04. At a burial, an accident happened and let to buildings burnt down in the fire. But the scene reeked of clues about a closed case of a massacre. There the story begins. 

Unlike the mysterious world of Tales of the Black Forest, the world in this game is full of horror. The gameplay can be pretty tense on a psychiatric level, but I can guarantee you’ll be content with how things turn out in the end. 

Story-telling is always the main focus of our studio. The story in this game is loaded with Chinese style occultism and realism, it may seem strange and bizarre, but similar things might be happening around us right now. 

Anyway, I hope this new attempt of mine can bring you joy as Tales of the Black Forest did. The link to our new game is down below. If you like what you see, please also add it to the wishlist. 

Thank you again for your support!

notes.title: Thank You For Playing My Game
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

This is 月光蟑螂, the developer of the game Tales of the Black Forest. 
I'd like to thank you for playing my game. 

The English version of this game is not available yet but it's almost done, it'll be implemented in a month or two. 

This game is the first game ever developed by the studio since I founded it. 
Started from October last year, it's almost a year now. 
We've devoted all the passion and backbending work we have - we understand that it's the necessary process for a indie game developer. It's what makes us grow stronger. I hope you can feel all that while playing my game. 

The game is developed while I was still learning to use RPG Maker, there's might be some imperfections but we're open to any suggestions. Please let me know what you think, and how we can do better. 

I would also like to thank those who helped in developing the game and our publisher, it was their effort combined that brought the game here. 

Last but not least, may you find the precious memory you've been missing in this adventure! 

月光蟑螂

Sep 26, 2019.
